extracted.intended_audience: NIH recipient institutions, Authorized Organization Representatives, research administrators, PD/PIs, and institutional officials responsible for NIH grants
extracted.subtask_short: NIH notification of PD/PI disciplinary action
extracted.subtask_description: A formal NIH policy requiring institutions that receive NIH grant or cooperative agreement funds to notify NIH when a PD/PI or other Senior/Key personnel named in a notice of award is removed or disciplined for harassment, bullying, retaliation, or hostile working conditions, including timeline, submitter, contents, and submission method requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notification requirement for removal or disciplinary action
rubrics_metrics.description: NIH recipient institutions are required to notify NIH when individuals identified as PD/PI or other Senior/Key personnel in an NIH notice of award are removed from their position or are otherwise disciplined by the recipient institution due to concerns about harassment, bullying, retaliation, or hostile working conditions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This requirement stems from the Consolidated Appropriations Act, 2022. It applies to removals or disciplinary actions taken by the recipient institution for those specific concerns and is distinct from other reporting requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Who must submit the notification
rubrics_metrics.description: Notifications must be provided by the Authorized Organization Representative (AOR).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The notice explicitly requires the AOR to submit the notification rather than, for example, the PI or another institutional official.

rubrics_metrics.name: Timeliness of notification
rubrics_metrics.description: Notification must be provided within 30 days of the removal or disciplinary action.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The 30-day deadline applies to the date of the institution's removal/disciplinary action; institutions should track timelines to ensure timely submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission method
rubrics_metrics.description: All notifications must be submitted to NIH through a dedicated web form.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use of the specified dedicated web form is required; other methods (email, mail) are not indicated as acceptable for these notifications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Minimum required content of notification
rubrics_metrics.description: All required notifications must include, at a minimum, the name of the Authorized Organization Representative submitting the notification, the name of the individual of concern, a description of the concerns, the action(s) taken, and any anticipated impact on the NIH-funded award(s).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide clear, specific descriptions to allow NIH to assess potential impacts; include anticipated impacts on one or more NIH-funded awards if known.

rubrics_metrics.name: Effective date of requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: The notification requirement is effective 60 days from the publication of this Notice.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Institutions should note the effective date to determine which removals/disciplinary actions fall under this requirement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope and applicability
rubrics_metrics.description: The requirement applies to institutions that receive funds through a grant or cooperative agreement during fiscal year 2022 and in future years.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Institutions with active NIH grants or cooperative agreements in FY2022 and thereafter must comply for covered personnel named in the notice of award.

rubrics_metrics.name: Disclosure requirement does not replace prior approval obligations
rubrics_metrics.description: This disclosure requirement does not replace existing requirements to obtain prior approval for any significant change in the status of the PD/PI or other Senior/Key Personnel specifically named in the notice of award.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Institutions must still follow NIH Grants Policy Statement procedures (e.g., prior approval processes) in addition to submitting these notifications when applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: NIH action if concern affects ability to serve as scientific lead
rubrics_metrics.description: If it is determined that the concerns shared with NIH will impact the PD/PI or senior key personnel's ability to continue as the scientific lead of the project, NIH will require prior approval for a replacement PD/PI or senior key official.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Institutions should anticipate that NIH review may be triggered when the reported concerns implicate the individual's capacity to lead the project, and plan institutional actions accordingly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inclusion of safety/work-environment information in prior approval requests
rubrics_metrics.description: When recipient institutions request prior approval for changes in PD/PI or other Senior/Key personnel or for a change in recipient institution, requests should include mention as to whether change(s) are related to concerns about safety and/or work environments (e.g., due to concerns about harassment, bullying, retaliation, or hostile working conditions), per NIH GPS 8.1.2.6 and 8.1.2.7.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When submitting prior approval requests under GPS sections cited, explicitly state if changes are related to safety or hostile work environment concerns to ensure NIH has relevant context.

rubrics_metrics.name: Related resources and institutional reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: For more information about how NIH addresses institutional notifications of harassment, bullying, retaliation, or hostile working conditions, see Institutional Reporting and NIH websites and linked resources on reporting allegations of harassment, discrimination, and other inappropriate conduct.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Institutions are directed to NIH webpages for further details, procedures, and resources; use those resources to understand reporting expectations and support available.

rubrics_metrics.name: Point of contact for inquiries
rubrics_metrics.description: Direct all inquiries to: Division of Grants Policy, Office of Policy for Extramural Research Administration, email [email protected].
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the provided contact for clarification on the notice, submission questions, or related policy interpretations.
